guitar.evidence: Justin Vernon primarily plays acoustic guitar on early Bon Iver material; not associated with one famous instrument.

tone.summary: A highly controlled, close-mic'd signal chain using a clean preamp (Comp/US Deluxe) followed by a low-gain amp (Silver Twin) and a small room simulation for subtle warmth.
